physicalGames.name: The Foam Parcel Relay
physicalGames.description: Pass oversized foam parcels along a low padded course, balancing each parcel before the next handoff. A dropped parcel is simply retrieved; no climbing or risky stunts.

physicalGames.name: Balloon Delivery
physicalGames.description: Carry soft balloon bundles between floor markers and invent a celebratory delivery pose. All movement stays on the padded studio floor.

interviewPrompts.name: An interest worth sharing
interviewPrompts.description: Tell us about a public hobby or interest and give a playful demonstration using imaginary objects.

interviewPrompts.name: A lesson from the stage
interviewPrompts.description: Describe something you learned during an earlier aired performance, then give the lesson a funny title.

interviewPrompts.name: Introduce your team
interviewPrompts.description: Introduce the teammates standing beside you as a fictional neighborhood club, using only what happened here today.

interviewPrompts.name: An ordinary day
interviewPrompts.description: Describe your ideal free afternoon and explain one harmless thing that could turn it upside down.

improvScenes.name: The Lost Property Office
improvScenes.description: A clerk, two visitors and a delivery worker try to return an ordinary object with an absurdly elaborate claim form.

improvScenes.name: The Neighborhood Weather Desk
improvScenes.description: A presenter and three correspondents report an imaginary shower of household objects while trying to keep the forecast useful.

improvScenes.name: The Almost Open Cafe
improvScenes.description: Four coworkers prepare to open a cafe while discovering that every everyday tool has been given the wrong label.

propBoxes.name: Office Odds and Ends
propBoxes.description: A foam telephone, blank clipboard, cloth hat and oversized cardboard key.

propBoxes.name: Picnic Mix-up
propBoxes.description: A soft basket, fabric napkin, foam loaf and empty plastic cup.

propBoxes.name: Household Surprises
propBoxes.description: A cardboard clock, feather duster, cloth scarf and soft toy parcel.
